arkivar.struktur.arkivnokkel.henvisning: See the series {arkivdel}. The class is not used for files in the case archive.
arkivar.struktur.arkivnokkel.om: The classification scheme is used in the case archive. It is fictional, made for Sirevåg kommune, and builds on the Norwegian central government’s common scheme (statens fellesnøkkel): classes 0, 1 and 2 cover the municipality’s own administration (organisation and administration, finance, positions and staff) and follow the common scheme, while 3–8 are the municipality’s service areas. On every level 0 means “general” and 9 means “other”. A file is placed on the lowest level: the group (three digits), or the main group (two digits) when it is not divided further. Class 9 is unused.
arkivar.struktur.arkivnokkel.treff: {antall, plural, =0 {No classes match the search.} one {# class} other {# classes}}
arkivar.struktur.ingress: How the archive of Sirevåg kommune is organised: the series, the file templates, the classification scheme, the registers the files are classified by, and the access codes.
arkivar.struktur.saksmaler.om: When you create a file, you choose a template. The series and a suggested title are then filled in, and you get a tip on how to search for the file first.
arkivar.vurdering.hjelp.samlemappe: The file also holds a document from the mail room that belongs to another case. Each case must have its own file.
arkivar.vurdering.hjelp.skjerm_klasse: In the person archives the classification is the date of birth and the name, and it must be hidden in the public journal. In the other series the classification reveals nothing and must stay open.
arkivar.vurdering.hjelp.skjerm_sakstitte: The title of the file reveals nothing that is exempt from public access and must stay open in the public journal. Only screen what has to be screened.
